argument:
The bull correctly notes that the CMS proposal is not a finalized quantified loss. That limits the precision of the downside estimate, not the existence of fresh regulatory uncertainty. Operating margin has weakened in both available sequential 2026 comparisons and FCF is below the preceding and year-ago observations.

The technical picture has also deteriorated: a high-volume decline broke the short and intermediate averages despite the still-positive long average. Positive earnings and lower year-ago debt do not resolve medical-cost, reserve or audit exposure. The recovery thesis presently depends on several unobserved improvements.
rebuttal_to_previous: Unknown regulatory impact is not asserted as a permanent quantified impairment, but neither can it support the bull's assumption that recovery conditions will prove manageable.
